verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents two bulk capabilities of its own. The HTTP Tracking API has a batch endpoint that submits multiple events in one request. Syncs write a model's full set of rows to a destination as inserts, updates or upserts, sending only changed rows via CDC. Neither the REST API nor the MCP server is documented as editing, pausing or triggering many syncs, audiences or models in one action, and Git Sync is only an adjacent programmatic path. missing for 10: bulk actions across many workspace resources (syncs, audiences, models), bulk/batch endpoints in the REST API, bulk operations via the MCP server for AI-native users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
